releaseNotes:
The Hockey section now lists the AHL: today's and the next three days' games with team logos and live scores. Their streams show up here as soon as a hockey site carries the game.

Fixed a crash on some boxes where the app closed by itself while sources were loading.

Sports: NHL, NFL, NBA, MLB, MLS, Soccer, College Basketball and College Football now open as game lists with both teams' logos and live scores. Each game has its own page with the records, top players with photos (goalies for hockey) and the stadium behind it, plus Play (the best stream starts by itself) and Select stream (the sources are searched and you pick one). The Hockey entry now lists the other hockey leagues.

Fixed: video links on adult pages that failed right after the app started on a slower TV (the host list is now loaded again at once if it failed), and the scenes of one title are numbered at the start of their name so they can be told apart. Also from 1.16.195: with English only on, torrent results that name another language beside English are hidden, and the file size limit covers results that report their size separately.

Fixed: adult links on slower TVs no longer end on a frozen screen when a video host could not be opened (the host list is loaded again if it failed once, and a page that is not a video is no longer handed to the player). With English only on, torrent results that name another language beside English are hidden, and the file size limit now also covers results that report their size separately.

Messages from the developer now show when the app starts (for example after the box is restarted) instead of being looked up all day. Fixed for sports: MethStreams links get a fresh address when you pick them, Strikeout, VIPLeague and Plavio links are no longer dropped on a slow box, SportSurge links get more time to appear, and TimStreams NFL games play.

Fixed for sports: MethStreams links are listed again and get a fresh address when you pick them (it expired within a minute before), Strikeout, VIPLeague and Plavio links are no longer dropped on a slow box, SportSurge links get more time to appear, TimStreams NFL games play, and leaving a stream no longer freezes the app.

New: Sports lists games from more sites - the smaller leagues of hockey, basketball and baseball, Rugby, Boxing, Golf and a More sports folder - with team logos, every live game at the top of its list, and NHL Network and WWE Network rows. New stream sources: Strikeout, VIPLeague, FawaNews, Aura Sports, WatchSports and Plavio (soccer and cricket feeds). New movie and TV source: Plavio HD (direct files, switch it in Settings > Sources). Fixed: SportsindX, PPV HD and TopEmbed links that stopped with a source error, a MotoGP weekend getting the wrong channels, and Strikeout players that would not start.

Fixed: a MotoGP race weekend no longer gets the F1 channel or football feeds for its links; it finds the MotoGP channels for the session that is on now or next.
